rules: Authenticate with the server-side auth provider.
Do not return or store plaintext passwords.
Create an httpOnly secure session cookie.
Return only authenticated user identity and authorized tenant summary.
Invalidate the server session and clear the auth cookie.

authorization: Dashboard routes require an authenticated session.
Tenant access is resolved through tenant_members.
A user's browser cannot select another tenant by changing tenant_id.
License status is checked server-side before premium/protected operations.
